pages.text: Dig a pool from 1x1 to 8x8 and fill it with still water. Rim it with Olympian marble (8 marble around a gold ingot) and put braziers on the 4 corners of the rim.
Light every brazier with the Promethean Torch (flint, gold, Olympian marble and a torch). The water turns gold: stand in it for 3 seconds. A brazier put out or broken closes the portal.
